decision: Use JSONL (not JSON) for all memory files
reasoning: Append-only, no merge conflicts, grep-friendly, each line is independent. Scales to millions of entries without parsing overhead.
Zero config, no API key, no install. Just a URL. GET https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/... returns PNG. ComfyUI as upgrade path for quality.

decision: Piper TTS + Whisper.cpp for voice stack
reasoning: Both run locally, both free, both fast (<200ms). No cloud dependency, no API limits. Mac Mini has enough power.

decision: All memory lives in nova/memory/ as JSONL files
reasoning: Git-tracked, version-controlled, readable by any session. Every session reads at start, writes at end. Compound intelligence.
